BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP2023)
CLASS:  IMSc   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH: MATHS & COMP.   SESSION : SP2023

SUBJECT: CS204 OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING & DESIGN PATTERNS
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    CO BL
Q1 (a) What are the features of Object – oriented Programming? Explain with examples. [2] 1 4
Q1 (b) What are Static Variables? What is the benefit of using it? [3] 2 2


Q2 (a) Correct errors (if any) and predict the output of the following code:
class Test
{   public static void main(String args[ ])
      {   int x = 2;     int y = 0;
           for(  ; y<10; ++y)
             {    if(y % x ==0)
                     continue;
                  else if(y == 8)
                      break;
                  else
                      System.out.println(y + “ ”);
             }
        }
 }
[2] 2 3
Q2 (b) What is a Constructor in Java? Explain different types of Constructors using suitable
program segment.
[3] 2 3


Q3 (a) How  multidimensional  arrays  are  declared?  Can  you  have  uneven  (irregular)
multidimensional arrays? Explain with a suitable example.
[2] 1 1
Q3 (b) What do you mean by Method Overloading in Java? Explain with suitable examples the
different conditions of achieving Method Overloading.
[3] 2 4


Q4 (a) Why String Class Objects are immutable in Java? Explain with an example. [2] 1 1
Q4 (b) What are Classes, Objects and Methods in Java? What is a Static Method? [3] 1 2


Q5  Write a Java Program to find duplicate characters in a string. (Eg. The string “Hello
Java” should return ‘l’ and ‘a’ as the duplicate characters.)
[5] 2 6

default and one parameterized that initializes the two data members. Create
two objects of this class. One object will call the method to find factorial of
the two integer data members and another would call a method that would
find Fibonacci series between the two numbers. Display the results.
[3] [2] [5]

[3] [2] [5]
